pluginstrument.type: CAP Mission Equipment Circuit Breaker Panel
pluginstrument.author: CAP V-SAR
pluginstrument.description: Observer-side circuit breaker panel for the SAR mission kit: one pull breaker each for the DF head, the TDFM-136B FM radio, and the audio panel/MFD mission feed. Pulling a breaker drops that system's power for emergency load management, same as the airframe's own ESS/AVN breakers, without affecting the other mission systems or the aircraft's electrical buses.
